# Perturbation theory {#sec-perturbation-theory}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon=false title="Learning goals"}
- Renormalize affine Toda theory in two dimensions: only tadpoles diverge, and Wick ordering removes them.
- Compute one-loop mass corrections and show the mass ratios are preserved in simply-laced theories.
- Understand anomalous thresholds and the Coleman–Thun mechanism for higher-order S-matrix poles.
:::
